_about: Petronius in English: W. C. Firebaugh's complete and unexpurgated Satyricon (Gutenberg treats it as US PD; Firebaugh d. 1945) and William Burnaby's. Clean Gutenberg. Firebaugh's text includes the Nodot and Marchena supplements (later forgeries), which his notes discuss. Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives.

petronius-firebaugh-satyricon: tr. W. C. Firebaugh; US PD per Gutenberg

petronius-heseltine-seneca-rouse: tr. Michael Heseltine (Petronius), W. H. D. Rouse (Seneca)

_excluded.pg5218-5224: Firebaugh split into 7 files; the complete PG 5225 kept
